title: Uwell Typhos Starter Kit
description:
The
Uwell Typhos Starter Kit
includes the Typhos pod device and pods for a complete out-of-the-box setup. Features a 2000mAh battery, up to 45W output, 1.05" HD display, and Storm/Waves modes with CoreShield anti-leak technology.
Product Type:
Open Pod Starter Kit
Pack Contents:
1x Uwell Typhos Device + 1x 0.3Ω Dual Mesh Pod + 1x 0.6Ω Mesh Pod + USB-C Cable
Battery:
2000mAh
Wattage Range:
18-45W
E-Liquid Capacity:
6mL
Coil Resistance:
Integrated (Real Dual Mesh / Single Mesh)
Display:
1.05" HD Colour Screen
Airflow:
Stepless Adjustable (MTL to RDL)
Charging Port:
USB Type-C
Compatible Pods:
Uwell Typhos Pods (0.3Ω, 0.6Ω, 0.8Ω)
Brand:
Uwell
E-liquid sold separately. Fill with your choice of salt nic or freebase e-liquid.
Available options: Polar Black, Starlight Silver.
